Header: Cassava mosaic virus Sinhala: Mangnokka mosaic virus rogaya, Tamil: Marawalli chiththira vadiwa vairasu, Vector: White fly ( Bemisia tabaci )

Prevention: Do not select fields close to infected cultivations/fields
Obtain planting materials from disease free healthy plants from disease free areas
Keep the field weed free especially during the early stage of the crop
Remove infected wild cassava plants around the fields (mostly along fences)
Establish live barriers using maize to protect the crop during the early stage
Monitoring: Observe for mosaic, mottling and chlorotic areas on leaves
Look for stunted plants with reduced leaf density
Direct Control: Rouging of diseased plants during first four months
Spray the crop with a suitable insecticide during first four months to control
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when applying pesticides
Don’t eat or drink while using pesticides and take suitable precautions when disposing of materials
Toxic to bees and beneficial insects
